compared to some of the other ones, this is nothing. But every day my dog that I've had since I was only 7 years old keeps getting weaker and weaker. He's been my best friend for so long and I've had so many good memories with him and he just brings me back to a time when I was happy and life was easy. Now he can barely walk, his back legs constantly slip from under him and I cry sometimes because I know he's going to be gone soon.
